Team only. The checks hotels chose to share (from “Do you need AI?” and from the earlier Readiness check), what they answered, and how the verdict was worked out.

Verdicts are recomputed with the current rules and compared with the verdict the hotel saw when it shared; each copy shows the rules version it was made with. Rules and question sources: D6 readiness data; reports "Hotel AI readiness check design" and "Readiness check retention and trust" (18 Nov 2026); "Council - readiness check audit" (20 Nov 2026).
